facts.text: The hotel is on the Shatti Al Qurum beachfront in Muscat.
facts.excerpt: W Muscat is a luxury, beach hotel in Muscat situated on the upbeat Shatti Al Qurum beachfront

facts.text: The rooftop infinity pool has panoramic views of the Shatti Al Qurum coastline.
facts.excerpt: Dive into luxury at W Muscat's iconic rooftop infinity pool. Enjoy panoramic vistas of Shatti Al Qurum's pristine coastline

facts.text: In the Wonderful Room, the ceiling echoes a desert tent and the minibar and closet are built from stacked luggage trunks.
facts.excerpt: The ceiling mirrors a desert tent's slanted structure, with tilted white paneling, fostering the warmth of a desert abode.

facts.text: The Royal Opera House Muscat is a stroll away over a walking bridge.
facts.excerpt: The Royal Opera House Muscat is practically our next-door neighbor—just a breezy stroll over the walking bridge.

facts.text: The WET Deck bar is inspired by the Bimmah Sinkhole, with floor-to-ceiling mirrors that reflect the ocean.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the Bimmah Sinkhole, a water-filled natural wonder in Oman, WET Deck is decorated with floor-to-ceiling mirrors which reflect glistening ocean vibes throughout the bar

facts.text: The Penthouse II has a DJ space and a bathtub lit by constellation lighting.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your stay with game table hawalis, a dedicated DJ space, and a luxurious bathtub crowned by star constellation lighting.

facts.text: Fabulous Rooms have private balconies overlooking the Gulf of Oman.
facts.excerpt: 40m² of chic luxury with private balconies overlooking the Gulf of Oman

facts.text: An AWAY Spa treatment room has a geometric skylight meant to feel like being deep underwater.
facts.excerpt: A geometrical skylight in the AWAY® Spa treatment room, floods the room with light from above, giving the feeling of being deep underwater.

facts.text: AWAY Spa has a Vichy shower.
facts.excerpt: Enhance any body treatment and wash away stress under the cleansing jets of the Vichy shower, located in the AWAY Spa.

facts.text: The hotel has two outdoor pools.
facts.excerpt: Dive into serenity in our two sun-drenched outdoor pools

facts.text: The tennis courts are lit for night play.
facts.excerpt: And with our courts bathed in brilliant lighting, why not turn your game set into a night match?

facts.text: The gym has Technogym equipment and sea views.
facts.excerpt: Discover the ultimate workout experience at the W Muscat Gym, where state-of-the-art Technogym equipment meets panoramic sea views.

facts.text: Zuma Muscat serves izakaya-inspired Japanese dining with Gulf of Oman views.
facts.excerpt: Experience Zuma Muscat at W Muscat, where contemporary Japanese izakaya-inspired dining meets Gulf of Oman views.

facts.text: The hotel strongly suggests reserving pool loungers and cabanas in advance.
facts.excerpt: Given the allure of our reserved seating – and trust us, they're quite the hotspot – we strongly suggest making a reservation.

facts.text: The rooftop infinity pool sits within Siddharta Lounge by Buddha-Bar.
facts.excerpt: Set the scene for an unforgettable tale at the infinity pool nestled within the stylish Siddharta Lounge by Buddha-Bar.
